instruction: Navigate to slide 1 and apply an orange background color.

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.hotkey('ctrl', 's'); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Task requires navigating to slide 1 (the first slide with index 0) and applying an orange background color. The evaluator checks if slide 1 has a solid fill background with RGB color (255, 165, 0) which is a standard orange. The metric function calculates the color distance and returns a score based on similarity with threshold 0.85 to allow for slight color variations. Verified that original presentation has 2 slides with BACKGROUND fill type (5).

Complete coverage: all instruction requirements are verified
